# Velip Developers

> Velip is a Brazilian communications platform: voice calls (text-to-speech, IVR, transfer, recording, browser softphone), SMS, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram and e-mail through one REST API (v2), plus an MCP server that exposes the same capabilities as tools for AI agents. This file lists every documentation page with a link to its raw Markdown.

Essentials for every REST request:

- URL: `https://<base>/api/v2/<Endpoint>.php`, where `<base>` is the account host (usually `vox.velip.com.br`).
- Token: a 30-character API token from the Velip portal (integrations screen), sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or as the `tsid` parameter. It acts on behalf of the whole account: keep it in a backend, never in browser code, and never ask the user to paste it in a chat.
- Request: `POST`, JSON or form encoding. URL parameters override JSON body keys.
- Response: JSON with `return.status` ("OK" or the error message) and `return.status_code` ("0" or the numeric error code). Data come inside `return` or in a sibling key, as each endpoint page shows.
- HTTP: 200 success, 400 validation, 401 authentication; some endpoints also use 403, 404, 409, 422, 429 and 5xx (listed on their pages).
- Pick the page by task in the "I want to..." table of the [repository home](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/README.md) or by area below.

## Start

- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/getting-started.md): base URL, request format, encoding, phone number format, a first example.
- [Authentication](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/authentication.md): API token, HTTP Basic, IP allowlist, brute-force protection.
- [Error codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/errors.md): numeric `status_code` values and HTTP statuses.
- [Rate limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/rate-limits.md): per-IP, per-user, per-channel and per-endpoint limits.
- [API v2 overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/overview.md): conventions and response shape.
- [API v2 index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/README.md): every endpoint by area.
- [Build your integration with an AI agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/ai-integration/README.md): ready prompts for CRM-triggered calls, a browser softphone and buying credit.

## SMS

- [MakeSMS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/sms/MakeSMS.md): send a single SMS.

## WhatsApp

- [MakeWhatsapp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/whatsapp/MakeWhatsapp.md): send text, media or a template (required outside the 24-hour window).
- [GetWATemplates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/whatsapp/GetWATemplates.md): list the approved templates of a line.
- [CreateWhatsappTemplate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/whatsapp/CreateWhatsappTemplate.md): submit a template to Meta for approval.
- [CheckTemplateStatus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/whatsapp/CheckTemplateStatus.md): approval status of a submitted template.
- [DeleteWhatsappTemplate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/whatsapp/DeleteWhatsappTemplate.md): delete a template.
- [ValidateWhatsAppNumber](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/whatsapp/ValidateWhatsAppNumber.md): check the Meta credentials and number of a Cloud API line.

## Voice

- [MakeTTSCall](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/voice/MakeTTSCall.md): outbound call with text-to-speech or recorded audio, IVR/DTMF, transfer, recording, result webhook (`rurl`).
- [GetCallStatus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/voice/GetCallStatus.md): call records, single or paginated, and the fields of the result webhook.
- [GetTTSVoices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/voice/GetTTSVoices.md): voices the account may use.
- [PlayAudioFile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/voice/PlayAudioFile.md): download or stream a stored audio or a call recording.
- [GetWebRTC](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/voice/GetWebRTC.md): SIP credentials of a browser softphone for one agent.
- [WebRTC softphone guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/voice/webrtc-softphone.md): calls from your own agent screen, with the browser code (JsSIP) and the `MakeTTSCall` that connects agent and customer.

## Audio files

- [CreateAudioFile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/audio-files/CreateAudioFile.md): generate a TTS audio or upload an audio file.
- [GetAudiosList](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/audio-files/GetAudiosList.md): list the account's audio files.

## Campaigns and queues

- [CreateCampaign](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/campaigns/CreateCampaign.md): voice campaign to many contacts (simple TTS, IVR questions, confirmation flow).
- [ChangeCampaign](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/campaigns/ChangeCampaign.md): change schedule, throughput or status of a campaign.
- [GetCampaignsList](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/campaigns/GetCampaignsList.md): search and list campaigns.
- [CreateCenterQueue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/campaigns/CreateCenterQueue.md): create a contact-center queue (voice or chat).
- [GetCenterQueues](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/campaigns/GetCenterQueues.md): list the active queues.

## Destinations

- [CreateDestinationBase](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/destinations/CreateDestinationBase.md): upload a destination list (CSV or JSON) for campaigns.
- [GetDestinationsList](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/destinations/GetDestinationsList.md): search destination lists and activate or deactivate them.

## Messenger and Instagram

- [MakeMessenger](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/messenger/MakeMessenger.md): send a Facebook Messenger message.
- [MakeInstagram](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/instagram/MakeInstagram.md): send an Instagram Direct message.

## E-mail

- [SendEmailOAuth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/email/SendEmailOAuth.md): send e-mail through the customer's Gmail or Microsoft 365 mailbox (OAuth), with free content or a template (`template_id` + `vars` as a JSON string) and up to 5 attachments; returns the `id` for GetMessageStatus.
- [SendGmailOAuth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/email/SendGmailOAuth.md): older Gmail-only version of SendEmailOAuth.

## Message status and reports

- [GetMessageStatus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/messages/GetMessageStatus.md): status of SMS, WhatsApp and e-mail sends (one message by `id`, `message_id` or `ctid`, or a list by period, campaign, recipient and status); normalized status, masked numbers, 200 lists per hour and 5,000 lookups per day.
- [GetMessageCampaignsList](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/messages/GetMessageCampaignsList.md): bulk SMS, WhatsApp and e-mail campaigns with state and optional delivery stats.
- [GetChannelSummary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/messages/GetChannelSummary.md): totals per channel (SMS, WhatsApp, e-mail, voice) for a period, by status and value.

## Credit purchase

- [CreatePixCharge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/credit/CreatePixCharge.md): buy credit with PIX; QR code, idempotent `reference`, account requirements.
- [GetChargeStatus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/credit/GetChargeStatus.md): status of a purchase (`credited` means the credit is in the balance) and the current balance; 60 requests per hour.

## Account

- [GetUserID](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/api/v2/auth-token/GetUserID.md): check that the credentials work and get the account ids.

## MCP server

- [MCP index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/mcp/README.md): the MCP server at `https://vox20.velip.com.br/mcpserver/velip` and its pages.
- [MCP overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/mcp/overview.md): what the server exposes and how it relates to the REST API.
- [MCP getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/mcp/getting-started.md): token, connectivity check, first SMS.
- [MCP authentication](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/mcp/authentication.md): Bearer tokens and their relation to the REST token.
- [MCP permissions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/mcp/permissions.md): channel access per token and tool filtering.
- [MCP tools reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/mcp/tools/README.md): one page per tool (`send_sms`, `make_tts_call`, `send_whatsapp`, `send_email`, message status and reports, campaigns, destination bases, templates and more).
- Clients: [Cursor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/mcp/clients/cursor.md), [Claude Desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/mcp/clients/claude-desktop.md), [curl](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/mcp/clients/curl.md), [custom client](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velipbr/velip-docs/main/docs/mcp/clients/custom.md).
